reason: B is the better proposal because W substitution is a concrete, compositionally plausible extension of the reported high-temperature strength retention of W-containing refractory HEAs, whereas heat treatment alone is not well justified to produce coherent B2 precipitates in Al-free TiVNbTa. B remains under-specified about which element is replaced and does not directly test lattice distortion or short-range order, but its intervention and composition-series experiment are more physically sound and falsifiable.
